text: What happened to the lost colony of Roanoke?
In fifteen eighty seven, one hundred and fifteen English colonists settled on Roanoke Island.
Their governor, John White, sailed back to England for supplies.
But a war with Spain kept him away for three long years.
When he finally came back in fifteen ninety, everyone was gone.
The houses had been taken down, and there was no sign of a fight.
Just one word, carved into a wooden post. Croatoan.
That was the name of a nearby island, and of the friendly people who lived there.
So maybe the colonists went to live with the Croatoan.
Or maybe they tried to sail home, and were lost at sea.
White never got to search the island. A storm drove his ships away.
So what do you think happened to them?
